card.name: Words just before achieving a goal
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, for, what, means or help in a sentence about a goal or objective, right where a verb like achieve or accomplish is expected next.

modes.label: Purpose phrase after a goal
modes.description: A word like To or toward opens a purpose clause right after a stated goal or aim.
modes.example: "Protect Life and Property."<< To>> help achieve this goal, a special alert

modes.label: Inside a goal-reaching clause
modes.description: A word in the middle of a clause about what must be done to accomplish an objective.
modes.example: determining<< what>> needs to be done to successfully accomplish the

card.plain: It fires on small words in a sentence about a goal, just before the text says the goal will be achieved.
